subject: Post-publish local runtime refresh
statement: After a successful published release, the updater refreshes an already-installed local devtools/agent runtime directly from the synchronized source tree. The refresh is payload-only, offline, idempotent, skips when no runtime exists, and post-publish refresh failures are warnings rather than rollback signals.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Ensure release updater refreshes an existing local dogfood runtime from the freshly published source tree without network access
